content:
incident-bot: [ALERT] autoscaler: GPU nodepool 'gpu-pool-prod' unable to scale. queue_length=1200, throttled_requests=340, time=2025-11-17T09:20:01Z
Jordan: paging... i'm oncall, grabbing logs
pd-bot: Paging Jordan (oncall-sre) for incident 78923 :rotating_light:
Maya: I'm on it, checking cluster-autoscaler logs now
Jordan: noted — customers reporting higher latency on /v1/generate
Maya: cluster-autoscaler logs (last 30s):
```
E1123 09:19:58.123456 1 scale_down.go:199] Failed to scale up: failed to launch instances: RequestLimitExceeded: The maximum number of allowed instances has been reached for the account
caused by: InvalidParameter: launchTemplate version mismatch for node-group gpu-pool-prod
error: AccessDenied: iam:PassRole on arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-node-role
```
Maya: also seeing: "No compatible launch template version found for instanceTypes=[p4d.24xlarge]"
Tess: @Maya is this the new launchtemplate that rolled last night? we did a template push at 01:00 UTC
Maya: yes, template v17 was created but autoscaler picks v15 from ASG
Samir: that would fail the ASG instance launch; ASG still points to older LT ID
Jordan: >customer impact: queue growth causing 5-15s added latency for Hosted API, some requests throttled. spike started ~09:05 UTC
Aisha: I'm flagging CS and measured error rates for top 3 customers; will compile list
customer-success-bot: Notifying affected customers list (prod tenants A,B,C) — outreach in progress
Maya: quick mitigation options:
1) Manually update ASG launch template to v17 (risky) 
2) Create an emergency ASG/nodegroup with compatible LT and attach to cluster (less risky)
3) Temporarily open instance limit with provider (if account max hit)
Jordan: we need something fast. prefer option 2 while we validate LT
Maya: executing emergency nodegroup creation now — using instanceType g5.12xlarge as fallback
```
# terraform-ish snippet for emergency ASG
resource "aws_launch_template" "emergency-gpu" {
  name = "emergency-gpu-1952468001"
  image_id = "ami-12345"
  instance_type = "g5.12xlarge"
  iam_instance_profile = "redwood-node-role"
}
```
Maya: created nodegroup, attaching taint to ensure only GPU workloads land: `node.kubernetes.io/gpu=true:NoSchedule`
Ryan: I'll watch pod scheduling and queue
Maya: cluster-autoscaler still logs `AccessDenied: iam:PassRole` when trying to use ASG's LT change — need iam permission for autoscaler role to pass new instance profile
Samir: granting iam:PassRole to autoscaler-role for the LT arn now
Samir: done — should allow ASG to launch using new profile
Maya: ASG launched 2 fallback nodes, kubelet joined, pods started scheduling to fallback nodes
Jordan: observed queued requests decrease: queue_length=1200 -> 480 in 3m
Tess: hooking up temporary routing: increase concurrency per worker to 2 to accelerate drain
Maya: after warmup we see token throughput improving, throttled_requests down from 340 -> 22
Aisha: confirmed customer A saw reduced errors, B and C still within SLO now
Maya: still have 2 tainted fallback nodes; planning to update the main LT and ASG after validation
Jordan: handing off to Ryan for post-incident follow-up and a full postmortem (include LT deployment guardrails and iam tests)
Ryan: taking on postmortem, will capture timeline, root cause: LT and ASG mismatch + missing iam:PassRole for autoscaler; action items: automation to sync LT ids, preflight iam check in rollout pipeline, incident runbook update
Maya: adding notes: add autoscaler unit tests for LT detection, create dashboard alerts for "LT mismatch" errors
Samir: will raise PR to update iam policy: allow autoscaler-role iam:PassRole on node instance profiles (PR #1423)
Jordan: any customer-facing update needed? Aisha?
Aisha: sending short incident update to affected customers, will post to status.redwood.ai
customer-success-bot: Customer notifications sent at 09:45 UTC
Jordan: marking incident as mitigated — queue draining, autoscaler now able to update ASG. keep thread open for 1h
Maya: thanks everyone, great fast work :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident 78923 status changed to MITIGATED by Jordan
Ryan: will schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow 16:00 UTC
Jordan: handing pager to oncall rotation, closing active pager
pd-bot: Pager cleared for incident 78923
Samir: leaving a short checklist in ops-runbooks/gpu-autoscale.md
Jordan: closing thread in 1h unless something pops up
